round1EvidenceContents: Power readings indicate the main generator is offline. Emergency lights in the lab are still on, running on backup batteries.
Multiple research loggers lost connection to the network exactly at midnight; this is when the main generator alarms sounded.
Security logs reveal that a storm struck the island at 11:30pm, with a single bolt of lightning recorded striking close to the Main Generator Room.
When backup generators were switched on, communication remained down island-wide, but water pumps worked.
